description: This file contains a script for formatting Python source code files using autopep8 and other tools, with command-line argument parsing and file processing functions.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the formatter script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to process files or standard input for formatting.

methods.name: _autopep8_options_for_style
methods.description: Returns autopep8 options based on the selected style.

methods.name: _fixers_for_quoting
methods.description: Returns fixers for string quote style based on user preference.

methods.name: _reformat_thunk
methods.description: Wrapper to call reformat_file with arguments.

methods.name: reformat_file
methods.description: Reads, reformats, and writes back a source file, optionally creating a backup.

methods.name: reformat_source
methods.description: Applies autopep8 and refactoring fixers to source code string.
